hazards.description: The wide, open road design with multiple lanes and a painted median encourages high vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, extending into the distance

hazards.name: Lack of crossings
hazards.description: No marked pedestrian crossings are visible, making it difficult and dangerous to cross the wide street.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible stretch of the road

hazards.name: Visual Barrier
hazards.description: The large retaining wall/fence structure blocks sightlines between the roadway and the pedestrian area on the far side.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of image, separating the road from the background buildings

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk on left side
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved pedestrian walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved surfaces.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible in the immediate vicinity, which would create significant safety concerns for pedestrians after dark.

hazards.name: Wide Painted Median
hazards.description: The wide, flush painted median increases the overall crossing distance and can encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Obstructed Narrow Sidewalk
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to maneuver around them, potentially into the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signals visible, making it difficult and dangerous for pedestrians to cross the wide street.

hazards.name: Obstructed and Narrow Sidewalk
hazards.description: A large corrugated metal fence is placed directly against the curb, leaving almost no room for pedestrians to walk safely away from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side of the road, extending across the background.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a central refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway where the yellow crosswalk is marked.

hazards.name: Hostile Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long metal fence creates a lack of 'eyes on the street', which can decrease the perceived and actual safety of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unprotected Bike Lane
hazards.description: The bike lane is only separated from motor vehicle traffic by paint, offering no physical protection.

hazards.name: Blank Frontages
hazards.description: Long stretches of industrial fencing reduce natural surveillance and create an uninviting pedestrian environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the property lines

hazards.name: Degraded Walkway Surface
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk is heavily cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no raised curb or physical buffer between the walkway and the travel lane, exposing pedestrians to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Transition between asphalt and concrete walkway

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The lack of marked crossings combined with a wide roadway increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers if they attempt to cross.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle on sidewalk
hazards.description: A red pickup truck is parked directly on the pedestrian walkway, forcing pedestrians into the high-speed roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled site access
hazards.description: The large open lot creates a continuous, undefined vehicle access point across the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no paved, separated walkway for pedestrians, forcing them onto the unpaved shoulder or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible block

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and a lack of vertical elements like trees or buildings at the sidewalk edge encourage high vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes in the center of the image

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked crossings or refuge islands, making it dangerous for pedestrians to cross between industrial sites.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Separation
hazards.description: The walkway is flush with the roadway, providing no physical barrier to prevent vehicles from entering the pedestrian space.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire street edge between the parked cars and the concrete area

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway at the distant intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Undefined vehicle access
hazards.description: The large open lot creates a wide, undefined area where vehicles may cross the sidewalk, increasing conflict points.
hazards.location_in_image: The perimeter of the vacant lot adjacent to the sidewalk

hazards.name: Large Undefined Driveway
hazards.description: A wide, open entrance to a commercial lot on the left creates a large conflict zone where vehicles can enter or exit at various angles across the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no trees, furniture, or parked cars to protect pedestrians from errant vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side sidewalk along the building frontage

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island in the center turn lane to facilitate safer crossings.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower driving speeds and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to narrow the roadway at crossing points, improving visibility and shortening the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to physically slow traffic in this residential area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with street trees or planters to separate the walkway from the roadway and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone or behind the sidewalk to ensure a continuous clear walking width.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide vertical enclosure, which naturally encourages slower driving speeds and improves the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curbing
interventions.description: Install a standard raised curb and a wider, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide physical and vertical separation from motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase the distance between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Designated Parking Markings
interventions.description: If parking is to be permitted, use clear pavement markings to define parking stalls and prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Utilize the center turn lane space to install a raised refuge island, allowing pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Install a row of street trees or a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement measures such as lane narrowing or speed reduction signage to lower vehicle speeds on this wide arterial.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical barriers between the bike lane and the travel lane to protect cyclists and provide a buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a raised pedestrian refuge island in the center median to reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with pedestrian warning signs to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at regular intervals or intersections to improve pedestrian visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians using the walkway at night.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Replace the painted median with a raised concrete island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians and reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and add a landscape buffer or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Remove the metal barrier and widen the sidewalk to provide a clear, accessible path for pedestrians that meets ADA standards.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the high-speed roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repave the walkway with smooth, continuous concrete to eliminate trip hazards and ensure ADA compliance.

interventions.title: Vertical Curb Installation
interventions.description: Install a standard vertical curb to provide physical and psychological separation between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards along the edge of the walkway to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Bollards
interventions.description: Install physical barriers or a planting strip to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk and to protect pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Management and Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Define specific entry and exit points for the adjacent lot to reduce the number of conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffering
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the new sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Raised Curb and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a standard raised curb and a planting strip or furniture zone to clearly define and protect the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Hardened Median with Bollards
interventions.description: Replace the flexible delineator posts with a permanent raised median to provide physical protection and better channelize traffic.

interventions.title: Consolidated Driveways
interventions.description: Replace the wide open access with defined, narrow driveways to minimize the pedestrian-vehicle conflict zone.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.
